newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major says Tories made Britain envy of Europe.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major says Tories made Britain envy of Europe.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major on Wednesday claimed his ruling Conservative Party had turned Britain into "the envy of Europe", cutting inflation, taxes and unemployment while Labour leader Tony Blair had done nothing to help the country grow.
Major said in a statement it was the Conservatives that had the ideas and ambitions to make Britian the best place in the world to live.
"It's the Conservative Party that has the practical policies to turn the have-nots into haves. It's the Conservative Party that has made Britain better," Major said.
"It hasn't all been plain sailing. Our difficulties have been well chronicled but I am proud of the real improvements we have helped people make to their quality of life."
Accusing Blair of making u-turns on his policy towards devolution to Scotland, unions and privatisation, Major said;

"For years he has been saying different things to different audiences. Now he is finally being caught out. His manifesto is falling apart under pressure, saying one thing one day and another thing the next is no basis for trust or competence.
